subject: Security & compliance follow-up: SOC 2 evidence, audit logs, DPA
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finpay.com>, Marcus Boyd <marcus.boyd@finpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Security & compliance follow-up: SOC 2 evidence, audit logs, DPA

Hi Elena / Marcus —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick written recap from our discovery call so we have clarity on the blockers and next steps. If I mis-state anything, please flag it and I’ll correct immediately.

Key pain points you shared
- SOC 2 compliance is a gating item for procurement; team needs the most recent SOC 2 Type II report and scope details.
- Audit logging / access logs: you need granular, per-request audit logs retained for 2+ years and the ability to export on-demand for audits.
- Data retention & deletion: legal requires clear retention policies, deletion flows, and proof of deletion for customer data.
- DPA & redlines: procurement will want a standard DPA with a few redlines around subprocessors and data residency.
- Pen test evidence: summary of third-party penetration testing and remediation notes.

Our goals from the conversation
- Provide SOC 2 artifact package and pen test summary for your security review this week.
- Confirm audit log retention mechanics and export method (API or S3 snapshot).
- Share a draft DPA and capture any legal redlines you anticipate.
- Schedule a 30–45 minute security deep-dive with your InfoSec folks next week to walk artifacts and technical controls.

Immediate next steps (owners & timeline)
1) Rishi: deliver SOC 2 report, pen-test summary, and a one-page audit log FAQ by EOD Monday (attached: Redwood_SOC2_Report_2025.pdf; pen_test_summary_2025.txt).
2) Marissa: compile configuration notes on audit log retention/export; confirm if we can provide 2-year retained logs and export format by Tue COB.
3) Aditya: prepare a draft DPA and list of current subprocessors for legal review — initial draft by Wed.
4) Elena / FinPay: send your security questionnaire (if you have one) and proposed times for a technical session; you mentioned procurement aims to sign by end of March.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Report_2025.pdf (summary + scope), pen_test_summary_2025.txt (high-level, no raw exploit data), FinPay_Security_Questionnaire_v3.xlsx (placeholder — please confirm your latest).

Proposed meeting slots for a deep-dive (PST): Mon 2/23 9:00–9:45, Tue 2/24 11:00–11:45, Wed 2/25 13:00–13:45. I’ll coordinate Zoom when you confirm.

Thanks — we want to make this as frictionless as possible.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0189

---
Attachment stubs:
- Redwood_SOC2_Report_2025.pdf (PDF, ~2.1MB)
- pen_test_summary_2025.txt (TXT, 1200 bytes)
- FinPay_Security_Questionnaire_v3.xlsx (XLSX, placeholder)

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finpay.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Boyd <marcus.boyd@finpay.com>, security@finpay.com <security@finpay.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Feb 2026 10:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security & compliance follow-up: SOC 2 evidence, audit logs, DPA

Thanks Rishi — appreciate the clear summary. A few clarifications from our side and our top priorities:  

Priority items for FinPay
- SOC 2 Type II report + scope (essential). We expect evidence of control monitoring for the last 12 months.
- Demonstrable export of audit logs in a machine-readable format (JSON/CSV) and the ability to run ad-hoc exports for audits.  
- DPA with explicit subcontractor disclosure and data residency language (we host payments data in us-west1 only).
- High-level pen test report is fine for now; our security team may request the vendor contact for independent verification.

I attached our security questionnaire (FinPay_Security_Questionnaire_v3.xlsx) with a few fields already filled out from today's call. Please note procurement's timeline: they want vendor terms finalized by 2026-03-26 to meet internal Q1 close.

We can do the deep-dive on Tue 2/24 11:00–11:45 PST. Marcus and two engineers from our security team (listed on the CC) will join.

Subject: Re: Security & compliance follow-up: SOC 2 evidence, audit logs, DPA

Marissa / Aditya —

Per Elena's note, FinPay confirmed Tue 2/24 11:00–11:45 PST for the technical deep-dive. Please treat this as high priority; procurement has a firm target to sign by 2026-03-26.

Action items (internal tasking)
- Marissa: pull the audit log export sample and write a short FAQ showing how to generate a JSON export and the retention policy. Also confirm whether we can provide an S3 snapshot workflow for auditors. Target: Tue 2/24 08:00 PST so we can demo live.
- Aditya: produce a first-pass DPA draft and a subprocessors list; flag any non-starters for legal. Target: Wed 2/25 COB.
- Rishi: I’ll upload SOC2 report and pen test summary to the shared drive and circulate the Zoom link. I’ll also add the DocuSign envelope once legal approves the DPA.

Elena — copying you so you have visibility into owners and timing. We’ll be ready to demo audit log exports at tomorrow’s deep-dive.

Thanks team — simple, pragmatic delivery will keep procurement moving.

Rishi
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
